name: LoRA Dataset Studio

software.description: Free local LoRA training studio: build captioned character, style and concept datasets from one photo or an image folder, train LoRAs with ai-toolkit and compare checkpoints side by side.
software.operating_system: Windows 10, Windows 11 (full local stack); Linux and macOS (API-only or manual environment); Docker

llms_summary: LoRA Dataset Studio (LDS) is a free, self-hosted LoRA training studio. It builds character, style and concept datasets from one reference photo or an image folder, captions them (JoyCaption or a local vision model, prose or booru tags), trains LoRAs with ai-toolkit for Krea 2, FLUX.1, FLUX.2 Klein, Qwen-Image 2.1, Z-Image, SDXL and Anima, and compares checkpoints side by side. It runs on your machine in one browser tab and uses ComfyUI for local generation and checkpoint tests.
llms_facts: License: PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0. Noncommercial use is free; commercial use requires separate permission from the licensor. LDS is not MIT-licensed.
Source code, issues and downloads: https://github.com/perfectgf/lora-dataset-studio (Windows ZIP, Git checkout, Docker, Pinokio).
Windows 10/11 runs the full local stack; Linux and macOS work for API-only use and a manual virtual environment; GPU Docker depends on host NVIDIA support.
Training uses ai-toolkit and local generation uses ComfyUI. Importing, sorting and manual captioning need no GPU or API key.
New versions reach Patreon members first, then everyone; the installed version stays free and keeps working.
LDS is not affiliated with loradataset.com.
